sources.title: NFL official injury report, 2026 Week 10
sources.scope: Player, position, injury text, practice status and game status for the published Week 10 report.
sources.limit: Mutable page. The two observations on the same day differ by 25 rows. It is not a point-in-time archive and carries no depth order, workload or replacement assignment.

sources.title: NFL injury report policy revisions (practice and game status definitions)
sources.scope: Official definitions: practice report is Did Not Participate, Limited Participation (less than 100 percent of a player's normal repetitions) or Full Participation (100 percent of normal repetitions). Game status: Questionable means uncertain whether the player will play; Doubtful means unlikely to participate; Out means the player will not play. 'Probable' was eliminated. A player certain to play is not listed in the Game Status Report.
sources.limit: Status labels are ordinal categories, not calibrated probabilities. Nothing in the policy quantifies replacement quality, snap share or performance impact.

sources.title: Washington Commanders depth chart
sources.scope: Published offensive, defensive and special-teams position order for the Commanders. Read directly this session to verify the centre and tight-end chains behind two players ruled Out.
sources.limit: No 'unofficial' disclaimer was present in the content read. Most positions publish two strings only; third and fourth strings are not published. Lucas Patrick, ruled Out by the league report, does not appear on this chart.

The committed repository capture labels these rows 'club depth chart'; that label is wrong and is flagged as OF-02.
